summary_zh: 美國商務部擬將半導體與AI晶片出口管制擴及泰國、新加坡、馬來西亞等七國，在泰華商須強化供應鏈合規審查。泰國同時加速汽車產業在地化，BOI配對71組企業，並將與中方簽署汽車合作備忘錄；泰美關稅協議細節未定，出口成本仍難預估。
summary_en: US plans to extend chip export controls to Thailand and six others, raising compliance pressure. Thailand pushes auto localization (BOI matched 71 firm pairs) and a China auto MOU, while Thai-US tariff details remain pending, keeping export costs uncertain.

items.title: 黃仁勳出軌曝漏洞 美嚴管遠端算力、晶片走私
items.summary_zh: 美國商務部擬將半導體出口管制擴及新加坡、馬來西亞、泰國等七國，以阻止中國企業遠端取得先進晶片。
items.summary_en: The US Commerce Department reportedly plans to extend semiconductor export controls to seven countries including Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand, to stop Chinese firms accessing advanced chips remotely.

items.title: 美補破網傳擴大 AI 出口管制 防止大陸遠端使用先進晶片
items.summary_zh: 美國商務部擬擴大對馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國等七國的AI晶片出口限制，最快11月公布。
items.summary_en: The US Commerce Department may expand AI chip export limits to seven countries including Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand, with an announcement possibly in November.

items.title: BOI配對71組企業 助力汽車零件製造商
items.summary_zh: 泰國政府加速汽車產業在地化，BOI配對71組企業，協助汽車零件製造商進入全球供應鏈。
items.summary_en: Thailand is accelerating local production in the auto industry; BOI has matched 71 company pairs to help auto parts makers enter global supply chains.

items.title: 中泰汽车产业五大领域合作再升级！拟于11月签署备忘录
items.summary_zh: 泰國內閣批准工業部與中方汽車產業在五大領域的合作，擬於11月簽署備忘錄。
items.summary_en: Thai cabinet approved cooperation with China in five auto industry areas; a memorandum is planned for signing in November.

items.title: 泰美關稅協議達成原則框架 細節待定
items.summary_zh: 泰美已達成關稅協議原則框架，但稅率、商品清單及時程尚未公布，仍待議會審議。
items.summary_en: Thailand and the US reached a framework on tariffs, but rates, product lists and timelines are unpublished and still need parliamentary review.
